---
title: "Python scenario explorer"
---

The [Excel dashboard](excel-dashboard.qmd) is available directly in the workbook.

The scenario explorer runs locally using Streamlit. It opens PEExcel project exports, filters variants and displays available reports.

From the repository directory:

```bash
python -m pip install -e ".[publication]" streamlit pyxlsb
python -m streamlit run apps/dashboard/main.py
```

Select the project export in the dashboard. The Excel reading engine required depends on file format. The file dialog needs a local desktop session.

The website's [example charts](examples.qmd) are static HTML files containing interactive Plotly figures. They do not require a running dashboard.
